title: Upper shriek carries canonical differentials between smooth proper curves
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes smooth of relative dimension one over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and assume their structure morphisms are proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism over $k$. Let $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ and $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ denote the full subcategories with quasi-coherent cohomology of the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of modules. Suppose $R:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ is supplied with an isomorphism of its composite with the full inclusion with $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and $R\dashv a$. Write $\Omega_X$ and $\Omega_Y$ for their relative Kahler differential sheaves [def-sc-kahler-differentials], and $\Omega[0]$ for the single complex in degree zero. Then there is an object $K$ of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ and an isomorphism $K\cong\Omega_Y[0]$ of underlying derived objects, with an isomorphism $a(K)\cong\Omega_X[0]$ of underlying derived objects. The chosen derived localizations may have arbitrary morphism universes.

source.place: Tags 0BRT and 0ATX, applied to X and Y over Spec k and to f followed by the structure map of Y

proof.text: Properness over the field makes X and Y Noetherian: proper implies finite type and quasi-compact, Spec k is Noetherian, and finite type over a Noetherian scheme is locally Noetherian. The same applies to Spec k itself. Choose restrictions of derived direct image for the structure maps and their right adjoints using [lem-pc-noetherian-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. The supplied comparison identifies R with the restriction of Rf_*; its right adjoint a is therefore f^!. For O_k, the single complex is quasi-coherent: its homology in degree zero is O_k and in every other degree it is zero. In Lean, the latter is identified with the free module on the empty type, which is quasi-coherent.

Apply [lem-sc-smooth-proper-curve-dualizing] to the structure maps g of Y and h of X, which are smooth proper of relative dimension one. For O_k in degree zero this gives g^! O_k isomorphic to Omega_Y[1] and h^! O_k isomorphic to Omega_X[1]. The single complex of Omega_Y is an object K of D_QCoh because Omega_Y is locally free (smoothness of relative dimension one) and its homology is Omega_Y in degree zero and zero in other degrees.

Use [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition] on the underlying ringed-space maps to obtain the derived composition isomorphism with its required right-derived-unit formula. Apply [lem-sc-proper-upper-shriek-composition] with that formula and the supplied comparison to obtain an isomorphism from h^! to g^! followed by a. Quasi-coherent derived objects are closed under isomorphisms and shifts: apply each homology functor to an isomorphism, and use its shift-sequence isomorphism to identify the homology of A[n] in degree m with that of A in degree n+m. These are proved private helpers, as is quasi-coherence of single complexes. Hence the full-subcategory inclusion commutes with shifts. The recorded unbounded derived direct image commutes with shifts via its existing right-derived-functor instance. Transfer that structure across comparison to R, and then to a using Adjunction.rightAdjointCommShift. Lift the isomorphism g^! O_k to Omega_Y[1] through the fully faithful inclusion, apply a to its inverse, compose with the inverse upper-shriek composition isomorphism and the isomorphism h^! O_k to Omega_X[1]. This gives a(K)[1] isomorphic to Omega_X[1] in the underlying derived category. The shift functor is an equivalence and is fully faithful, so preimageIso cancels the shift. Finally rewrite h as the structure map of X using the over-k identity.

lean.statement: theorem smoothCurve_upperShriek_differentials (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper f] (R : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (comparison : R ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ≅ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (adj : R ⊣ a) : ∃ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y, ∃ _eL : K.obj ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)).relativeDifferentials, Nonempty ((a.obj K).obj ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).relativeDifferentials)
